explanation.en: The first two lines create distinct training and validation inputs. error and gradient use training arrays only. The subtraction updates the scalar weight. Both losses are recomputed after the update for a consistent comparison. The if block saves the best validation state; scalar assignment copies its value. Five epochs here mean five full-batch updates. The synthetic line is learned, but no real neural application is evaluated.
explanation.zh: 前两行建立不同的训练与验证输入。error 和 gradient 只用训练数组，减法更新标量权重。两种损失都在更新后重算，确保比较一致。if 保存最佳验证状态，标量赋值会复制数值。这里五轮就是五次整批更新。代码确实学习合成直线，但未评估真实神经网络应用。

title.en: Regularization: train with noise, evaluate deliberately
title.zh: 正则化：训练时引入噪声，评估时明确模式

story.en:
Sofia trains a network on instrument sounds. Training accuracy rises, but validation accuracy stops improving. She tests dropout, which removes some hidden activations during training. The changed model needs a fair comparison on the same reserved recordings.

During a demo, one sound receives different scores on repeated runs. Sofia finds that the model is still in training mode. Each run uses a different dropout mask. Evaluation mode removes that source of randomness. She controls gradient recording separately. The incident teaches two lessons: choose regularization using evidence, and set the model’s execution mode deliberately when using the result.
story.zh:
索菲亚用乐器声音训练网络。训练准确率上升，验证准确率却不再改善。她尝试 dropout，在训练中移除部分隐藏激活，并用相同保留录音公平比较改动。

演示时，同一个声音多次运行得到不同分数。索菲亚发现模型仍在训练模式，每次使用不同 dropout 掩码。评估模式消除了这部分随机性，梯度记录则另行控制。这件事让她理解：正则化要由证据选择，使用模型时也要明确设置执行模式。

concept.en:
Dropout randomly removes selected activations during training. In inverted dropout, survivors are divided by their survival probability. This keeps each activation’s expected value unchanged. Expected value means the average over repeated random masks, not the value in every run.

At evaluation, this dropout layer passes values through. A framework’s evaluation mode changes layers such as dropout and batch normalization. Disabling gradient recording does a different job: it avoids storing a derivative graph. Neither switch automatically performs the other one’s job.
concept.zh:
Dropout 在训练中随机移除部分激活。反向缩放 dropout 把保留下来的值除以保留概率，使每个激活的期望不变。期望指重复随机掩码后的平均，不是每次运行都得到同一个值。

评估时，这个 dropout 层直接传递输入。框架的评估模式改变 dropout、批归一化等层的行为。关闭梯度记录则是另一件事：避免保存导数图。两种开关不会自动替代彼此。

application.en: Compare regularization settings using the same reserved data and a clearly defined selection metric. Keep training and evaluation mode changes visible in the workflow. During ordinary validation, select evaluation behavior and avoid recording gradients unless the analysis needs them. If scores remain unstable, inspect augmentation and other random operations as well; changing the dropout mode cannot remove every source of variation.
application.zh: 使用同一份预留数据和明确的选择指标比较正则化设置。在工作流程中显式标明训练与评估模式切换。普通验证时选择评估行为，并在分析不需要梯度时关闭梯度记录。如果分数仍不稳定，还应检查数据增强及其他随机操作；改变 dropout 模式无法消除全部变化来源。

practice.en: PyTorch’s Dropout reference specifies random zeroing and survival scaling during training, followed by identity behavior during evaluation. The Module reference documents evaluation mode as affecting modules such as dropout and batch normalization. These are operational distinctions in a real library, not merely terminology. They explain why a saved set of weights must be paired with an appropriate evaluation procedure.
practice.zh: PyTorch 的 Dropout 参考文档明确说明了训练时随机置零与按存活概率缩放，以及评估时的恒等行为。Module 参考文档说明，评估模式会影响 dropout 和批归一化等模块。这些是实际库中的运行差异，而不只是术语。它们解释了为什么保存一组权重时，还必须配套适当的评估流程。

topics.formula:
mⱼ ∼ Bernoulli(1−p), 0 ≤ p < 1
h̃ⱼ = mⱼhⱼ/(1−p)
E[h̃ⱼ | hⱼ] = hⱼ
Var(h̃ⱼ | hⱼ) = hⱼ²p/(1−p)
h_eval,ⱼ = hⱼ

symbols.en: hⱼ is activation j before dropout, treated as fixed when computing the expectation. p is the probability of dropping that activation, so 1−p is its survival probability. mⱼ is a binary mask drawn from a Bernoulli distribution: one means retained and zero means removed. h̃ⱼ is the random training output after survival scaling. E denotes expectation, Var denotes variance, and the vertical bar means conditioning on the original activation. h_eval,ⱼ is the corresponding evaluation output. The subscript j selects one element; ordinary elementwise dropout samples a mask for each element.
symbols.zh: hⱼ 是 dropout 前的第 j 个激活，在计算期望时将其视为固定值。p 是丢弃该激活的概率，所以 1−p 是存活概率。mⱼ 是来自伯努利分布的二值掩码：一表示保留，零表示删除。h̃ⱼ 是按存活概率缩放后的随机训练输出。E 表示期望，Var 表示方差，竖线表示以原始激活为条件。h_eval,ⱼ 是对应的评估输出。下标 j 选择一个元素；普通逐元素 dropout 会为每个元素采样掩码。

calculation.en: Take a fixed activation hⱼ = 4 and dropout probability p = 0.25. With probability 0.75 the output is 4/0.75 = 16/3; otherwise it is zero. Its expectation is 0.75×16/3 = 4. Its second moment is 0.75×(16/3)² = 64/3, so the variance is 64/3 − 4² = 16/3, approximately 5.3333. For a vector [2, 4] and one sampled mask [1, 0], the training output becomes [8/3, 0]. In evaluation it is [2, 4]. One random pass clearly differs from the expected value. Preserving the mean therefore does not remove training noise, nor does it promise that a downstream nonlinear prediction equals the average prediction across all masks.
calculation.zh: 取固定激活 hⱼ = 4，dropout 概率 p = 0.25。输出以 0.75 的概率为 4/0.75 = 16/3，否则为零。其期望为 0.75×16/3 = 4。二阶矩为 0.75×(16/3)² = 64/3，所以方差为 64/3 − 4² = 16/3，约为 5.3333。对于向量 [2, 4] 和一次采样得到的掩码 [1, 0]，训练输出为 [8/3, 0]；评估输出则为 [2, 4]。一次随机前向传播显然不同于期望值。因此，保持均值并不消除训练噪声，也不保证下游非线性预测等于所有掩码下预测的平均值。

limits.en: Dropout can hurt when it removes information a small model already struggles to use. Its rate and placement need validation. Evaluation mode does not itself freeze parameters or disable gradients, and disabling gradients does not switch dropout off. Other regularizers, augmentations, and normalization layers have their own behavior and should not be treated as interchangeable.
limits.zh: 当小模型本来就难以利用信息时，dropout 删除这些信息可能反而有害。其比例和位置需要验证。评估模式本身不会冻结参数，也不会关闭梯度；关闭梯度也不会关闭 dropout。其他正则化方法、增强方式和归一化层各有行为，不能视为可互换的方法。

takeaway.en: Regularization is a training choice; evaluation mode and gradient recording are separate execution choices that must match the purpose of each pass.
takeaway.zh: 正则化是训练选择；评估模式与梯度记录是独立的执行选择，都必须符合每次前向传播的目的。

meaning.en: Zero-or-one choices saying which activations survive a training pass.
meaning.zh: 表示某次训练中哪些激活保留的零一选择。

meaning.en: The probability-weighted average over possible outcomes.
meaning.zh: 按概率加权的可能结果平均值。

meaning.en: A layer-behavior setting for evaluation, distinct from gradient recording.
meaning.zh: 用于评估的层行为设置，与梯度记录不同。

question.en: Why divide a surviving value by 0.75?
question.zh: 为什么保留值要除以 0.75？

answer.en: It survives only 75% of passes. Multiplying survival probability 0.75 by the scaled value h/0.75 gives expected value h.
answer.zh: 它只有 75% 的次数被保留。保留概率 0.75 乘缩放值 h/0.75，期望仍为 h。

question.en: Why can one output be zero while the expectation is four?
question.zh: 为什么一次输出可以为零，期望却为四？

answer.en: Expectation averages possible outcomes. A dropped activation is zero in that run. Other runs use a larger surviving value to balance the average.
answer.zh: 期望平均所有可能结果。某次被丢弃就为零，其他次数使用较大的保留值，使平均得到平衡。

question.en: Does equal mean preserve the whole network prediction?
question.zh: 均值相同就保持整个网络预测吗？

answer.en: Not necessarily. Later nonlinear operations can change averages. The exact statement here concerns the dropout layer’s activation expectation.
answer.zh: 不一定。后续非线性操作可能改变平均。这里的精确结论仅针对 dropout 层激活的期望。

body.en: Apply masks [1,0] and [0,1] to [2,4] with p=0.25. Compare their outputs with the unchanged evaluation input. A fixed demonstration mask is not random training.
body.zh: 对 [2,4] 用 p=0.25，分别应用掩码 [1,0] 与 [0,1]。比较两者输出与评估时不变的输入。固定演示掩码不等于随机训练。

body.en: For a framework model, set evaluation behavior and disable gradient recording separately. If scores still vary, inspect random preprocessing and other operations before blaming dropout.
body.zh: 对框架模型分别设置评估行为与关闭梯度记录。若分数仍波动，先检查随机预处理和其他操作，再判断是否与 dropout 有关。

title.zh: 精确计算 dropout 结果

intro.en: Enumerate scalar outcomes and use a fixed vector mask for repeatable output.
intro.zh: 枚举标量结果，并用固定向量掩码保证输出可重复。

code_examples.code:
import numpy as np
probability = 0.25; h = 4.
outcomes = np.array([0., h/(1-probability)])
weights = np.array([probability, 1-probability])
expected = weights @ outcomes
variance = weights @ (outcomes-expected)**2
vector = np.array([2.,4.]); mask = np.array([1.,0.])
print(f'expectation: {expected:.6f}; variance: {variance:.6f}')
print('training:', np.round(mask*vector/(1-probability),6).tolist())
print('evaluation:', vector.tolist())

explanation.en: outcomes lists dropped and surviving scalar values. weights stores their probabilities. The two dot products compute expectation and variance exactly, without sampling. The fixed mask illustrates one possible vector pass. Evaluation returns the original vector. The code demonstrates the dropout mechanism; it does not train or validate a sound model.
explanation.zh: outcomes 列出被丢弃和保留的标量值，weights 保存其概率。两次点积精确计算期望与方差，无需抽样。固定掩码展示一种可能的向量传播，评估则返回原向量。代码演示 dropout 机制，没有训练或验证声音模型。

title.en: Normalization: state which values share statistics
title.zh: 归一化：说明哪些值共享统计量

story.en:
Mara inspects hidden features in a sound model. Some rows have large offsets and others have small ones. She wants a predictable scale before the next transformation. She tries subtracting a mean and dividing by a standard deviation. The calculation looks simple, but one question changes everything: which values supply those statistics?

Mara compares each row’s own features with values pooled across examples. These are different operations. She chooses layer normalization for the current sketch and writes the feature axis explicitly. She also keeps a small positive number in the denominator. The result is repeatable, even when a row has no variation.
story.zh:
玛拉检查声音模型的隐藏特征，有些行整体数值很大，有些很小。她希望下一步变换前的尺度更可控，于是尝试减均值、除标准差。计算似乎简单，但一个问题会改变一切：统计量来自哪些值？

玛拉比较每行自己的特征与跨样本汇总的值，两者是不同操作。她为当前草图选择层归一化，并明确标出特征轴。分母还加入一个小正数，让一行没有变化时也能稳定计算。

concept.en:
Layer normalization computes a mean and variance over chosen feature axes within each example. Subtract the mean, divide by the square root of variance plus epsilon, then optionally apply learned scale and offset. The scale and offset let training restore useful ranges.

Batch normalization uses statistics across a batch and possibly spatial axes, depending on the layer. Its evaluation often uses running statistics. Layer normalization uses the current example’s selected axes in both training and evaluation. Neither operation is the same as fitting an input scaler once on training data.
concept.zh:
层归一化在每个样本内部，沿指定特征轴计算均值和方差。先减均值，再除以方差加 epsilon 后的平方根，最后可应用学习的尺度与偏移。尺度和偏移让训练恢复有用范围。

批归一化跨批次统计，具体层还可能包含空间轴，评估时通常使用运行统计量。层归一化在训练和评估时都使用当前样本的指定轴。两者都不同于只在训练数据上拟合一次的输入缩放器。

application.en: Use an explicit axis definition when adding normalization to a sequence or image network. Test a batch containing examples with very different means. Changing one example should not change another under this per-example layer-normalization rule.
application.zh: 在序列或图像网络中加入归一化时，明确指定轴。用均值差异很大的样本组成批次测试。在这里逐样本层归一化规则下，改变一个样本不应改变另一个。

practice.en: PyTorch’s LayerNorm reference defines the selected last dimensions, population-style variance, and learned scale and offset. Its BatchNorm2d reference documents running statistics. The example isolates layer normalization with identity scale and zero offset.
practice.zh: PyTorch LayerNorm 文档定义所选末尾维度、总体形式方差及学习尺度与偏移。BatchNorm2d 文档说明运行统计量。本例单独演示尺度为一、偏移为零的层归一化。

topics.formula:
μ = (1/d)Σⱼ xⱼ; v = (1/d)Σⱼ(xⱼ−μ)²
hⱼ = γⱼ (xⱼ−μ)/√(v+ε) + βⱼ

symbols.en: xⱼ is feature j of one example and d counts its normalized features. μ is their mean and v their population variance. ε is a small positive constant preventing a zero denominator. γⱼ and βⱼ are learned scale and offset. hⱼ is the normalized output. This formula describes one example at a time.
symbols.zh: xⱼ 是单个样本的第 j 个特征，d 是参与归一化的特征数。μ 为其均值，v 为总体方差，ε 为防止分母为零的小正数。γⱼ、βⱼ 为学习尺度与偏移，hⱼ 为归一化输出。公式逐个样本计算。

calculation.en: For [1,3], mean is 2 and variance is ((−1)²+1²)/2=1. With γ=[1,1], β=[0,0], and ε=0.00001, output is about [−0.999995,0.999995]. For [10,14], mean is 12 and variance is 4, giving about [−0.999999,0.999999]. Epsilon makes variance close to, not exactly, one.

limits.en: Normalization can remove useful magnitude information. Axis mistakes change the operation. Learned scale and offset mean final outputs need not have zero mean or unit variance. Batch-normalization state needs a deliberate evaluation policy.
limits.zh: 归一化可能去掉有用的幅度信息。轴错误会改变操作。学习尺度与偏移使最终输出不必均值为零、方差为一。批归一化状态需要明确评估策略。

takeaway.en: A normalization formula is incomplete until you name its axes, variance convention, and behavior at evaluation.
takeaway.zh: 只有说明轴、方差约定与评估行为，归一化公式才完整。

meaning.en: Normalization over selected feature axes within one example.
meaning.zh: 在单个样本内部沿指定特征轴归一化。

meaning.en: Here, the average squared distance of values from their mean.
meaning.zh: 这里是各值到均值之差的平方平均。

meaning.en: A small positive constant added to keep a denominator well defined.
meaning.zh: 加入分母相关计算、使其有定义的小正数。

question.en: Why keepdims=True when taking row means?
question.zh: 计算行均值时为什么 keepdims=True？

answer.en: It keeps one column of means with shape batch×1. Subtraction then applies each mean to its own row instead of accidentally aligning another axis.
answer.zh: 它保留形状为批次×1 的均值列。相减时，每个均值用于自己那一行，避免意外对齐别的轴。

question.en: What happens to [5,5]?

answer.en: Its centered values and variance are zero. Epsilon makes the denominator positive, so normalized values are [0,0] before learned offset.
answer.zh: 中心化值与方差均为零。Epsilon 使分母为正，因此加学习偏移前输出 [0,0]。

question.en: Does layer normalization need the other examples in the batch?
question.zh: 层归一化需要同批其他样本吗？

answer.en: Under this row-wise rule, no. Each row supplies its own statistics. This differs from a batch-based rule.
answer.zh: 按这里逐行规则，不需要。每行提供自己的统计量，与跨批次规则不同。

body.en: Add 100 to both entries of the second row. The first normalized row stays unchanged. This checks per-example separation.
body.zh: 给第二行两项都加 100。第一归一化行保持不变，检查了逐样本隔离。

body.en: After normalization, multiply the second feature by two. Its spread changes. Learned scales can intentionally change the output range after the standardized step.
body.zh: 归一化后把第二特征乘二，它的范围会变化。学习尺度可以在标准化步骤之后有意改变输出范围。

intro.en: Use the population variance convention and an explicit epsilon.
intro.zh: 使用总体方差约定与明确的 epsilon。

code_examples.code:
import numpy as np
x = np.array([[1.,3.], [10.,14.]])
mean = x.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)
variance = ((x-mean)**2).mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)
normalized = (x-mean)/np.sqrt(variance+1e-5)
print('means:', mean.ravel().tolist())
print('variances:', variance.ravel().tolist())
print('normalized:', np.round(normalized,6).tolist())
print('row means:', np.round(normalized.mean(axis=1),6).tolist())

explanation.en: axis=1 selects features within a row; keepdims keeps statistics aligned for broadcasting. Centered squares averaged along the same axis give population variance. The denominator uses variance plus epsilon before the square root. ravel is used only to display one-dimensional statistics. This arithmetic omits trainable scale and offset, equivalent to choosing them as one and zero.
explanation.zh: axis=1 选择行内特征，keepdims 保持统计量对齐以便广播。中心化差值平方后沿相同轴平均得到总体方差。分母先将方差加 epsilon，再开平方。ravel 仅为把统计量显示为一维。运算省略可训练尺度与偏移，等价于分别取一和零。

title.en: Convolutions and residual paths: local evidence, preserved routes
title.zh: 卷积与残差路径：局部证据与保留的通路

story.en:
Jun photographs metal samples with small scratches. A scratch can appear in many parts of the frame. He wants the same local detector to work at each position. A sliding filter reuses one set of weights across the image, so each location does not need a separate detector.

Jun then stacks many layers. He adds a shortcut that carries an input around a group of transformations. The group can learn a correction to that input. His sketch now separates two ideas. Convolution shares a local operation over space. A residual connection adds a direct route through the network. Both still require suitable data and training.
story.zh:
俊拍摄带细小划痕的金属样本。划痕可能出现在画面各处，他希望同一个局部检测器能用于不同位置。滑动滤波器在图像上重复使用一组权重，因此不必为每个位置单独建检测器。

俊随后堆叠多层，并添加捷径，让输入绕过一组变换。这组变换可以学习对输入的修正。他的图现在区分两件事：卷积在空间共享局部操作，残差连接则增加直接穿过网络的路径。两者仍需合适数据与训练。

concept.en:
A convolutional layer slides a small weight table over nearby entries. Reusing the table is called weight sharing. Most neural-network libraries use cross-correlation: the filter is not reversed. Stride is the distance between positions; padding adds entries around the boundary.

A residual connection adds an input to a learned correction. The two arrays must have matching shapes and aligned meanings. If dimensions differ, a learned projection may change one branch. Convolution and residual addition solve different structural problems. A shortcut does not make every deep network easy to train.
concept.zh:
卷积层让一个小权重表在相邻条目上滑动。重复使用权重表称为权重共享。多数神经网络库使用互相关，即不翻转滤波器。步幅是相邻位置的间距，填充是在边界外增加条目。

残差连接把输入加到学习出的修正上。两个数组必须形状匹配、含义对齐。维度不同时，可用学习到的投影改变一条分支。卷积与残差相加解决不同结构问题。捷径并不会让所有深网都容易训练。

application.en: Use local filters when nearby structure and repeated spatial patterns are useful assumptions. Track the spatial size after every change in stride or padding. Before adding a residual branch, confirm that both branches agree in shape and feature alignment. Compare training and validation behavior separately: an optimization improvement from a shortcut does not by itself establish a gain on unseen images.
application.zh: 当邻域结构和重复空间模式是有用假设时，使用局部滤波器。每次改变步长或填充后，都要追踪空间尺寸。在加入残差分支之前，确认两条分支的形状和特征位置一致。分别比较训练与验证行为：捷径带来的优化改善，本身并不能证明未见图像上的表现也会提高。

practice.en: The original ResNet paper evaluates residual networks for image recognition and also uses their features in object detection experiments. It describes identity shortcuts and projections for mismatched dimensions. PyTorch’s Conv2d reference specifies the cross correlation operation and spatial sizing rules. Together they connect an implemented local operator with a documented architecture that places learned transformations alongside shortcut paths.
practice.zh: ResNet 原论文在图像识别中评估残差网络，并在目标检测实验中使用其特征。论文说明了恒等捷径，以及维度不匹配时使用的投影。PyTorch 的 Conv2d 参考文档规定了互相关运算和空间尺寸规则。两者将具体实现的局部算子，与在学习变换旁设置捷径路径的实际网络结构联系起来。

topics.formula:
Z[i,j] = b + Σ(u=0…k−1) Σ(v=0…k−1) K[u,v]X[i+u,j+v]
H_out = floor((H + 2p − k)/s) + 1
y = x + F(x;θ)

symbols.en: X is one input image channel, K is a square kernel of width k, b is a scalar bias, and Z is its output. i and j select an output location; u and v index kernel entries. The first equation assumes unit stride and no padding. H is input height, p is padding on each side, s is stride, and H_out is output height with unit dilation; floor rounds downward. In the residual equation, x and y are compatible feature tensors, F is the learned branch, and θ contains its parameters. Σ denotes summation.
symbols.zh: X 是图像的一个输入通道，K 是边长为 k 的方形卷积核，b 是标量偏置，Z 是输出。i 和 j 选择输出位置，u 和 v 索引卷积核元素。第一个公式假定步长为一且没有填充。H 是输入高度，p 是每侧填充量，s 是步长，H_out 是膨胀率为一时的输出高度；floor 表示向下取整。在残差公式中，x 和 y 是形状兼容的特征张量，F 是学习分支，θ 包含其参数。Σ 表示求和。

calculation.en: Let X = [[1, 0, 2], [2, 1, 0], [0, 3, 1]], K = [[1, 0], [0, −1]], and b = 0. With no padding and unit stride, the output height is floor((3−2)/1)+1 = 2, and the width is also 2. The four window calculations are 1−1 = 0, 0−0 = 0, 2−3 = −1, and 1−1 = 0. Thus Z = [[0, 0], [−1, 0]]. Separately, consider a residual input x = [2, −1] and a learned correction F(x;θ) = [0.5, 0.25]. Their sum is [2.5, −0.75]. If this block applies ReLU after the addition, its final output is [2.5, 0]. Distinguishing the sum from the subsequent activation prevents an incorrect shortcut calculation.
calculation.zh: 设 X = [[1, 0, 2], [2, 1, 0], [0, 3, 1]]，K = [[1, 0], [0, −1]]，b = 0。没有填充且步长为一时，输出高度为 floor((3−2)/1)+1 = 2，宽度也为 2。四个窗口的计算依次为 1−1 = 0、0−0 = 0、2−3 = −1，以及 1−1 = 0。因此 Z = [[0, 0], [−1, 0]]。另考虑残差输入 x = [2, −1]，学习得到的修正 F(x;θ) = [0.5, 0.25]。两者之和为 [2.5, −0.75]。如果该残差块在相加后应用 ReLU，最终输出为 [2.5, 0]。区分相加结果与后续激活，能避免错误计算捷径输出。

limits.en: Weight sharing does not create complete invariance to translation, rotation, or scale; boundaries and downsampling matter. A shortcut cannot add tensors whose dimensions or semantic alignment disagree. Residual networks still depend on suitable initialization, optimization, data, and capacity. The two dimensional toy filter here illustrates arithmetic, not a complete scratch detector.
limits.zh: 权重共享不会带来对平移、旋转或尺度的完全不变性；边界和下采样都会产生影响。捷径不能直接相加维度不符或语义位置不一致的张量。残差网络仍依赖合适的初始化、优化、数据和容量。本节二维玩具滤波器只演示算术，并不是完整的划痕检测器。

takeaway.en: Convolution shares local evidence across positions; residual connections preserve a route around transformations. Their benefits come from different structural choices.
takeaway.zh: 卷积在不同位置共享局部证据；残差连接保留绕过变换的通路。两者的作用来自不同的结构选择。

meaning.en: A small table of weights reused at many input positions.
meaning.zh: 在多个输入位置重复使用的小权重表。

meaning.en: The number of positions moved between neighboring filter applications.
meaning.zh: 两次相邻滤波操作之间移动的位置数。

meaning.en: Adding an input representation to a learned correction with compatible shape.
meaning.zh: 把输入表征与形状兼容的学习修正相加。

question.en: Why does a 3×3 input with a 2×2 filter give 2×2 output?
question.zh: 3×3 输入配 2×2 滤波器为何输出 2×2？

answer.en: With stride one and no padding, the filter can start at two row positions and two column positions. That gives four windows.
answer.zh: 步幅一、无填充时，滤波器有两个行起点与两个列起点，共四个窗口。

question.en: Why is the lower-left output −1?
question.zh: 左下输出为什么为 −1？

answer.en: That window is [[2,1],[0,3]]. The nonzero filter weights select 2 and subtract 3, giving −1.
answer.zh: 窗口为 [[2,1],[0,3]]。非零滤波权重选中 2 并减去 3，得到 −1。

question.en: Can we add tensors just because their entry counts match?
question.zh: 元素数量相同就能做残差相加吗？

answer.en: No. Axis shapes and feature alignment must match. A reshape that merely makes sizes fit can silently mix different meanings.
answer.zh: 不能。轴形状与特征含义必须对齐。仅为了尺寸匹配而重塑，可能悄悄混合不同含义。

body.en: Replace the input with all ones. The filter has weights summing to zero, so every valid window gives zero. This shows local contrast detection rather than object recognition.
body.zh: 把输入改为全一。滤波权重之和为零，因此每个有效窗口输出零。这展示局部对比检测，而不是物体识别。

body.en: Add [2,−1] and [0.5,0.25]. First obtain [2.5,−0.75]. Apply ReLU only afterward to get [2.5,0]. Keep those two operations separate.

title.en: Slide a filter and add a shortcut
title.zh: 滑动滤波器并添加捷径

intro.en: Two separate calculations illustrate two different mechanisms.
intro.zh: 两个独立计算演示两种不同机制。

code_examples.code:
import numpy as np
x = np.array([[1.,0.,2.], [2.,1.,0.], [0.,3.,1.]])
kernel = np.array([[1.,0.], [0.,-1.]])
out = np.zeros((2,2))
for row in range(2):
    for col in range(2):
        out[row,col] = np.sum(x[row:row+2,col:col+2] * kernel)
residual_sum = np.array([2.,-1.]) + np.array([0.5,0.25])
print('filter output:', out.tolist())
print('residual sum:', residual_sum.tolist())
print('after ReLU:', np.maximum(0,residual_sum).tolist())
code_examples.output:
filter output: [[0.0, 0.0], [-1.0, 0.0]]
residual sum: [2.5, -0.75]
after ReLU: [2.5, 0.0]

explanation.en: The nested loops choose each valid window. Slicing extracts its 2×2 entries. Elementwise multiplication and sum compute cross-correlation without flipping the kernel. The residual calculation adds matching coordinates; maximum applies a later ReLU. This hand-chosen filter is not a trained scratch detector, and the residual vector is a separate example.
explanation.zh: 嵌套循环选择各个有效窗口。切片取出 2×2 条目，逐元素相乘再求和，实现不翻核的互相关。残差计算按对应坐标相加，maximum 随后应用 ReLU。这个手选滤波器不是训练好的划痕检测器，残差向量也是独立示例。

title.en: Token embeddings: turn IDs into trainable vectors
title.zh: 词元嵌入：把编号变为可训练向量

story.en:
Tess wants to classify short robot instructions. Words cannot enter a matrix multiplication directly. She first splits a sentence into tokens and assigns each token an integer ID. She then looks up a small vector for each ID.

Tess pads short sequences so a batch has a common length. Her first average includes padding and shrinks the shorter sentence’s features. She adds a mask and averages only real tokens. Then she swaps two words and sees that the average stays the same. The lookup and mask now work, but she needs position-aware processing when order changes an instruction’s meaning.
story.zh:
苔丝想分类机器人短指令。词不能直接进入矩阵乘法，她先把句子拆成词元，为每个词元分配整数编号，再按编号查找小向量。

苔丝用填充让同批序列长度一致。最初平均时包含填充，导致短句特征缩小。她加入掩码，只平均真实词元。后来交换两个词，发现平均值仍不变。查表和掩码已经正确，但当词序影响指令含义时，还需要感知位置的处理。

concept.en:
An embedding table has one vector per vocabulary ID. Looking up an ID selects a row. The integer is an address, not a numeric meaning: token 8 is not twice as meaningful as token 4. Training changes table entries through the task loss.

Padding adds placeholder positions to equalize sequence lengths. A mask says which positions are real. Masked mean pooling sums real-token vectors and divides by their count. Pooling produces one sequence vector but loses order. Position embeddings or sequence models can provide order information later.
concept.zh:
嵌入表为每个词表编号保存一个向量。查编号就是选行。整数是地址，不是数值含义：词元 8 并不比词元 4 意义大一倍。训练通过任务损失改变表项。

填充加入占位位置，使序列等长。掩码指出哪些位置真实。掩码均值池化加总真实词元向量，再除以其数量。池化得到单个序列向量，却丢失顺序。后面可用位置嵌入或序列模型提供顺序信息。

application.en: Embedding lookup is a building block for text classifiers and language models. Keep tokenizer and vocabulary consistent between training and use. Exclude padding from relevant averages and losses. Inspect unknown-token handling before interpreting an embedding.
application.zh: 嵌入查表是文本分类器与语言模型的组成部分。训练与使用时保持分词器和词表一致。有关平均与损失要排除填充。解释嵌入前，检查未知词元处理。

practice.en: PyTorch’s embedding reference documents integer lookup into a weight table. Its word-embedding tutorial shows trainable word vectors in small language tasks. Our vectors are hand chosen to isolate lookup, padding, and pooling.
practice.zh: PyTorch 嵌入文档说明按整数查权重表。词嵌入教程展示小型语言任务中的可训练词向量。这里的向量为手选，单独演示查表、填充与池化。

symbols.en: E is a V×d embedding table, with V vocabulary entries and d numbers per vector. tᵢ is the token ID at position i; eᵢ is the selected row. T is padded sequence length. mᵢ is one for a real token and zero for padding. s is the pooled vector. At least one mask entry must be one.
symbols.zh: E 是 V×d 嵌入表，V 为词表条目数，d 为向量维数。tᵢ 是位置 i 的词元编号，eᵢ 是选中行。T 为填充后的序列长度。真实词元 mᵢ 为一，填充为零，s 为池化向量。至少一个掩码项必须为一。

calculation.en: Let robot map to [1,0], moves to [0,2], and padding to [0,0]. The sequence [robot,moves,padding] has mask [1,1,0]. The masked sum is [1,2] and count is 2, giving mean [0.5,1]. Dividing by padded length 3 would incorrectly give [1/3,2/3] for the intended real-token mean.
calculation.zh: robot 映射为 [1,0]，moves 为 [0,2]，填充为 [0,0]。序列 [robot,moves,padding] 的掩码为 [1,1,0]，掩码和为 [1,2]，计数为 2，均值为 [0.5,1]。若除以填充长度 3，会错误地得到 [1/3,2/3]，不再是真实词元均值。

limits.en: Lookup alone does not create semantic understanding. The training task shapes vector meaning. Averaging is insensitive to order. An all-padding sequence has zero count and needs explicit handling before division.
limits.zh: 查表本身不产生语义理解，训练任务塑造向量含义。平均对顺序不敏感。全填充序列计数为零，除法前需明确处理。

takeaway.en: Treat token IDs as addresses, preserve masks, and distinguish a lookup vector from a context-aware representation.
takeaway.zh: 把词元编号当作地址，保留掩码，并区分查表向量与有上下文的表征。

meaning.en: A trainable table assigning a vector to each vocabulary ID.
meaning.zh: 为每个词表编号分配向量的可训练表。

meaning.en: Placeholder positions added to match sequence lengths.
meaning.zh: 为了统一序列长度而增加的占位位置。

meaning.en: Combining many position vectors into a smaller summary, such as a mean.
meaning.zh: 将多个位置向量合为较小摘要，例如均值。

question.en: Why is ID 2 not twice ID 1?
question.zh: 为什么编号 2 不是编号 1 的两倍？

answer.en: IDs only select rows in a table. Their numeric spacing has no intended language meaning. The selected vectors carry learned information.
answer.zh: 编号只选择表中的行，数值间距没有预设语言含义。选出的向量承载学到的信息。

question.en: Why divide by two rather than three?
question.zh: 为什么除以二而不是三？

answer.en: Only two positions are real tokens. The mask excludes the placeholder from both the sum and denominator.
answer.zh: 只有两个位置是真实词元。掩码从分子与分母中都排除占位项。

question.en: Can the pooled vector distinguish robot moves from moves robot?
question.zh: 池化向量能区分 robot moves 与 moves robot 吗？

answer.en: Not with this mean. Addition ignores order. A position-aware architecture must retain or add information beyond the unordered average.
answer.zh: 这个均值不能。加法忽略顺序。感知位置的结构必须保留或增加无序平均之外的信息。

body.en: Append another padding ID and mask zero. The masked mean must stay [0.5,1]. An unmasked mean would change again.
body.zh: 追加一个填充编号与掩码零。掩码均值必须仍为 [0.5,1]；没有掩码的均值会再次改变。

body.en: Reserve an unknown ID in a toy vocabulary. Use it for unseen text instead of inventing a new untrained row during evaluation. Inspect how often it appears.
body.zh: 在玩具词表中保留未知编号。评估时用它表示未见文本，不要临时编造新未训练行。检查它出现的频率。

title.en: Look up tokens and ignore padding

intro.en: The final table row is padding; the vectors are illustrative, not learned.
intro.zh: 表的最后一行表示填充；向量为示意值，未经学习。

code_examples.code:
import numpy as np
table = np.array([[1.,0.], [0.,2.], [0.,0.]])
ids = np.array([0,1,2]); padding_id = 2
vectors = table[ids]
mask = ids != padding_id
pooled = (vectors*mask[:,None]).sum(axis=0)/mask.sum()
reversed_ids = np.array([1,0,2])
reversed_mean = table[reversed_ids][reversed_ids != padding_id].mean(axis=0)
print('vectors:', vectors.tolist())
print('real-token count:', int(mask.sum()))
print('masked mean:', pooled.tolist())
print('reversed mean:', reversed_mean.tolist())
code_examples.output:
vectors: [[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 2.0], [0.0, 0.0]]
real-token count: 2
masked mean: [0.5, 1.0]
reversed mean: [0.5, 1.0]

explanation.en: table[ids] selects a row for each position. The comparison creates a Boolean mask. [:,None] adds a feature-broadcasting axis so each position’s mask applies to its whole vector. Sum over axis zero combines positions, and mask.sum counts real tokens. The reversed sequence has the same mean, exposing the loss of order. This code performs lookup and pooling only.
explanation.zh: table[ids] 为每个位置选一行。比较生成布尔掩码。[:,None] 添加特征广播轴，让每个位置的掩码作用于整个向量。沿轴零求和组合位置，mask.sum 统计真实词元。逆序得到相同均值，展示顺序丢失。代码只执行查表与池化。

title.en: Attention: retrieve context with learned comparisons
title.zh: 注意力：通过学习到的比较提取上下文

story.en:
Amara compares two notes about a pump and a valve. The notes use similar words but reverse which part failed. Averaging all word vectors loses much of this difference. She needs each position to gather context that is useful for that position.

Amara gives a position a query. It compares the query with keys, then mixes value vectors using the resulting weights. She adds position information so order can matter. For next-token prediction, she also masks future positions. Her drawing now explains one attention head. It still needs other layers and training before it can become a useful language model.
story.zh:
阿玛拉比较两条关于泵与阀门的笔记。用词相似，却交换了故障部件。平均词向量丢失了许多差别，她需要让各位置获取对自己有用的上下文。

阿玛拉为一个位置设置查询，让它与键比较，再按得到的权重混合值向量。她添加位置信息，使顺序能发挥作用。预测下一个词元时，还遮住未来位置。她的图现在解释了一个注意力头，但要成为有用语言模型，还需要其他层与训练。

concept.en:
Attention is a weighted average of value vectors. Queries ask what is relevant; keys provide vectors to compare with. A dot product gives each query-key pair a score. Divide by the square root of key width, then apply the softmax from the loss chapter. Each row of weights sums to one.

A mask prevents forbidden connections. A causal mask blocks future positions during next-token prediction. Self-attention gets queries, keys, and values from the same sequence. Cross-attention can read another sequence. Attention alone does not encode order, so models also need a position mechanism.
concept.zh:
注意力是值向量的加权平均。查询表示要寻找什么，键提供用于比较的向量。点积给每对查询与键打分，再除以键宽度的平方根，随后使用损失章节学过的 softmax。每行权重之和为一。

掩码禁止不允许的信息连接。预测下一个词元时，因果掩码阻止访问未来。自注意力从同一序列取得查询、键和值，交叉注意力可读取另一序列。注意力本身不编码顺序，所以模型还需要位置机制。

application.en: Specify what each query may read before choosing an attention mask. Track query length, key length, and feature dimensions separately, especially in cross attention. Test a tiny case in which a forbidden position contains an extreme value; changing it should not change an output that cannot attend to it. Treat padding and causal restrictions as distinct masking requirements.
application.zh: 选择注意力掩码之前，先明确每个查询允许读取哪些位置。分别追踪查询长度、键长度和特征维度，尤其是在交叉注意力中。用一个很小的示例检查掩码：让禁止访问的位置包含极端数值；改变这个数值，不应影响无法关注该位置的输出。将填充限制与因果限制视为不同的掩码要求。

practice.en: Vaswani and colleagues introduced the Transformer in Attention Is All You Need and evaluated it on machine translation. The original paper specifies scaled dot product attention, multiple heads, positional encodings, and masked decoder attention. This is a documented sequence modeling use of the mechanism. The maintenance narrative and numerical vectors here explain its operation without reproducing the paper’s experiments or claiming their results.
practice.zh: Vaswani 及其同事在《Attention Is All You Need》中提出 Transformer，并在机器翻译上进行评估。原论文说明了缩放点积注意力、多头机制、位置编码和带掩码的解码器注意力。这是该机制在序列建模中的实际研究应用。本节的维护记录情境和数值向量用于解释运算，并未复现论文实验，也不宣称获得了论文结果。

topics.formula:
S = QKᵀ/√dₖ + M
A[i,j] = exp(S[i,j]) / Σ(r=1…nₖ) exp(S[i,r])
O = AV

symbols.en: Q contains n_q query rows with dₖ features each. K contains nₖ key rows with the same dₖ features; Kᵀ is its transpose. V contains nₖ value rows with dᵥ features. S is the score matrix and M an additive mask, zero for allowed connections and negative infinity for blocked ones. A contains attention weights, and O contains n_q output rows with dᵥ features. i indexes queries; j and r index keys. exp is the exponential function, Σ sums over keys, and √dₖ is the positive square root. Each query must have an allowed key.
symbols.zh: Q 包含 n_q 行查询，每行有 dₖ 个特征。K 包含 nₖ 行键，使用相同的 dₖ 个特征；Kᵀ 是其转置。V 包含 nₖ 行值，每行有 dᵥ 个特征。S 是分数矩阵，M 是加性掩码：允许连接的位置为零，禁止连接的位置为负无穷。A 包含注意力权重，O 包含 n_q 行输出，每行有 dᵥ 个特征。i 索引查询；j 和 r 索引键。exp 是指数函数，Σ 沿键求和，√dₖ 是正平方根。每个查询至少必须有一个允许访问的键。

calculation.en: Use one query Q = [[√2, 0]], two keys K = [[1, 0], [0, 1]], and values V = [[2, 0], [0, 4]]. The key dimension dₖ is 2. Before masking, scaled scores are [√2/√2, 0/√2] = [1, 0]. Softmax gives [exp(1)/(exp(1)+1), 1/(exp(1)+1)] ≈ [0.731059, 0.268941]. The output is therefore approximately [1.462117, 1.075766], a weighted combination of the two value vectors. If the second key is forbidden, use mask [0, −∞]. Its weight becomes zero and the first weight becomes one, yielding [2, 0]. The mask changes what information is available, not merely how strongly a forbidden position is preferred. These values describe one head before any output projection.
calculation.zh: 使用一个查询 Q = [[√2, 0]]、两个键 K = [[1, 0], [0, 1]]，以及值 V = [[2, 0], [0, 4]]。键维度 dₖ 为 2。加入掩码前，缩放分数为 [√2/√2, 0/√2] = [1, 0]。Softmax 得到 [exp(1)/(exp(1)+1), 1/(exp(1)+1)] ≈ [0.731059, 0.268941]。因此输出约为 [1.462117, 1.075766]，即两个值向量的加权组合。如果禁止访问第二个键，就使用掩码 [0, −∞]。第二个权重变为零，第一个权重变为一，输出为 [2, 0]。掩码改变的是哪些信息可用，而不仅是对禁止位置的偏好强弱。这些数值描述单个注意力头在输出投影之前的结果。

limits.en: Dense attention forms a score for every query and key pair, which can be costly for long sequences. Attention weights are not automatically faithful causal explanations. Missing positional information, incorrect masks, or entirely masked rows can invalidate an otherwise plausible computation. The small example omits learned projections and the other components needed for a complete Transformer.
limits.zh: 稠密注意力为每对查询和键计算分数，长序列下成本可能很高。注意力权重并不自动构成可信的因果解释。缺少位置信息、掩码错误或整行被完全遮蔽，都可能让看似合理的计算失效。这个小示例省略了学习投影及完整 Transformer 所需的其他组件。

takeaway.en: Attention chooses how to mix available context; dimensions, positional information, and masks determine what that choice can actually mean.
takeaway.zh: 注意力决定如何混合可用上下文；维度、位置信息与掩码，共同决定这种选择究竟具有怎样的含义。

meaning.en: The comparison request, comparison target, and vector to be mixed.
meaning.zh: 用于提出比较、接受比较以及被混合的三类向量。

meaning.en: One set of query, key, and value projections and its context mixing.
meaning.zh: 一组查询、键、值投影及其上下文混合计算。

meaning.en: A rule that prevents a position from reading later positions.
meaning.zh: 阻止一个位置读取后续位置的规则。

question.en: Why do scores [1,0] not give weights [1,0]?
question.zh: 为什么分数 [1,0] 不产生权重 [1,0]？

answer.en: Softmax exponentiates both finite scores. exp(0)=1, so the second position retains positive weight. A mask is needed to forbid it.
answer.zh: Softmax 对两个有限分数都取指数。exp(0)=1，因此第二位置仍有正权重。禁止它需要掩码。

question.en: How does the output’s second coordinate become 1.075766?
question.zh: 输出第二坐标如何变成 1.075766？

answer.en: The first value contributes zero there. The second contributes 0.268941×4, about 1.075766.
answer.zh: 第一个值向量在该坐标贡献零，第二个贡献 0.268941×4，约为 1.075766。

question.en: What happens if every key is masked?
question.zh: 如果所有键都被遮住会怎样？

answer.en: The row has no allowed source. A softmax over all negative infinities is undefined. Design masks so each required query has a valid source or use an explicit special rule.
answer.zh: 这一行没有允许的信息源。对全负无穷做 softmax 未定义。设计掩码时应确保必要查询有有效来源，或规定明确的特殊规则。

body.en: Mask the second key, then replace its value with [1000,1000]. The output should remain [2,0]. This directly checks the information boundary.
body.zh: 遮住第二个键，再把其值改为 [1000,1000]。输出应仍为 [2,0]。这直接检查信息边界。

body.en: For a three-token sequence, draw which positions each query may read. Query zero may read only zero; query one may read zero and one. Do not let training use future targets as context.
body.zh: 对三个词元画出各查询可读取的位置。查询零只能读零，查询一可读零和一。不要让训练把未来目标当上下文。

title.zh: 比较允许与遮蔽的上下文

intro.en: This is one numerical head before learned output projections.
intro.zh: 这是学习输出投影之前的单头数值示例。

code_examples.code:
import numpy as np
q = np.array([[np.sqrt(2.),0.]])
k = np.array([[1.,0.], [0.,1.]])
v = np.array([[2.,0.], [0.,4.]])
scores = q @ k.T / np.sqrt(k.shape[1])
def softmax(row):
    values = np.exp(row-row.max(axis=-1,keepdims=True))
    return values/values.sum(axis=-1,keepdims=True)
weights = softmax(scores)
masked = softmax(scores + np.array([[0.,-np.inf]]))
print('weights:', np.round(weights,6).tolist())
print('output:', np.round(weights @ v,6).tolist())
print('masked output:', (masked @ v).tolist())

explanation.en: @ forms pair scores, and .T aligns key vectors as columns. The scale uses the key dimension, not sequence length. softmax subtracts each row maximum for stability. Negative infinity produces zero exponential for the forbidden key. The final multiplication mixes values. The vectors are hand chosen; no tokenization, language training, or full Transformer is implemented here.
explanation.zh: @ 生成配对分数，.T 将键向量排成列。缩放使用键维度而非序列长度。softmax 减去行最大值以保持稳定。负无穷让被禁止键的指数为零，最后矩阵乘法混合值。向量是手选的，示例未实现分词、语言训练或完整 Transformer。

title.en: A Transformer block: combine the pieces
title.zh: Transformer 模块：把组件接起来

story.en:
Wei can calculate an attention head, but a language-model diagram still looks crowded. It contains normalization, additions, and another network around the attention box. He redraws one block using only the operations he has already studied.

Wei follows two token vectors through normalization, masked attention, and a residual addition. Then a small feedforward network transforms each position separately, followed by another residual addition. The sequence length and feature width stay fixed. He tests the block with hand-chosen weights before thinking about training. The diagram now describes a computation he can trace. It is still only one component, not a complete language model.
story.zh:
韦能计算一个注意力头，但语言模型图仍显得拥挤：注意力方框周围还有归一化、加法和另一个网络。他只用已经学过的操作重画一个模块。

韦让两个词元向量依次经过归一化、带掩码注意力与残差相加，然后由小型前馈网络逐位置变换，再做一次残差相加。序列长度与特征宽度始终不变。他先用手选权重检查模块，再考虑训练。现在这张图描述的是可追踪计算，但它仍只是组件，不是完整语言模型。

concept.en:
A Transformer block combines attention, position-wise feedforward layers, residual connections, and normalization. Attention mixes information across positions. The feedforward network changes features within each position using shared weights. Residual routes keep an additive path around each transformation.

The block below uses pre-normalization: normalize before each transformation, then add its output to the residual stream. Other arrangements exist, including the original paper’s post-normalization form. Our example has one attention head and a causal mask. Position information is assumed to have been supplied before the block; the toy values do not encode a real sentence.
concept.zh:
Transformer 模块组合注意力、逐位置前馈层、残差连接与归一化。注意力跨位置混合信息，前馈网络用共享权重改变各位置内部特征，残差提供绕过变换的加法路径。

下面采用前置归一化：每次变换前归一化，再把输出加回残差流。还有其他排列，例如原论文的后置归一化。本例只有一个注意力头和因果掩码。假设位置信息在模块之前已提供；玩具数值不编码真实句子。

application.en: Transformer blocks support sequence tasks such as language modeling and translation. When inspecting an implementation, check mask direction, normalization placement, feature widths, and whether residual branches align. Verify one block before stacking many.
application.zh: Transformer 模块支持语言建模与翻译等序列任务。检查实现时，核对掩码方向、归一化位置、特征宽度与残差分支对齐。先验证一个模块，再堆叠多个。

practice.en: The original Transformer paper describes the components and translation task. PyTorch’s TransformerEncoderLayer reference documents feedforward layers and a norm_first option. This example explicitly chooses a small pre-normalization variant and does not reproduce a pretrained architecture.
practice.zh: 原 Transformer 论文介绍组件与翻译任务。PyTorch TransformerEncoderLayer 文档说明前馈层与 norm_first 选项。本例明确选择微型前置归一化变体，不复刻预训练架构。

topics.formula:
U = LN(X)
Y = X + Attention(U,U,U)
Z = Y + ReLU(LN(Y)W₁+b₁)W₂+b₂

symbols.en: X is the sequence table with one token per row. LN is per-token layer normalization. U is its normalized form. Attention uses U as query, key, and value in this identity-projection example. Y is the first residual sum. W₁, b₁, W₂, b₂ are feedforward parameters. Z is the block output. All additions preserve the same sequence length and feature width.
symbols.zh: X 是每行一个词元的序列表，LN 是逐词元层归一化，U 是其归一化结果。在这个恒等投影示例中，注意力以 U 同时作为查询、键和值。Y 是第一次残差和，W₁、b₁、W₂、b₂ 为前馈参数，Z 是模块输出。所有加法保持相同序列长度与特征宽度。

calculation.en: Use two identical rows [1,−1] and a very small epsilon. Normalized rows are approximately [1,−1]. The first query can read only itself, so weights are [1,0]. The second sees two equal scores, so weights are [0.5,0.5]. Both context vectors are approximately [1,−1]. The first residual gives [2,−2]. Here I = [[1,0],[0,1]] is the identity matrix. Multiplying by it leaves a vector unchanged. With W₁=I, W₂=0.5I and zero biases, the feedforward correction is about [0.5,0], giving final rows [2.5,−2].
calculation.zh: 使用两个相同的行 [1,−1] 与很小 epsilon，归一化后约为 [1,−1]。第一查询只能读自己，权重为 [1,0]；第二查询看到两个相等分数，权重为 [0.5,0.5]。上下文向量均约为 [1,−1]。第一次残差得到 [2,−2]。这里 I = [[1,0],[0,1]] 是单位矩阵，乘以它不会改变向量。取 W₁=I、W₂=0.5I、偏置零，前馈修正约为 [0.5,0]，最终行约为 [2.5,−2]。

limits.en: The toy omits multiple heads, learned query/key/value projections, dropout, and a vocabulary output head. Identical rows make the arithmetic easy but do not test rich context behavior. A working block alone has no learned language ability.
limits.zh: 玩具例子省略多头、学习到的查询键值投影、dropout 与词表输出头。相同行使计算简单，却没有测试丰富上下文行为。模块能运行本身不意味着学会语言。

takeaway.en: A Transformer is a structured composition of familiar operations. Trace each branch and state the chosen variant.
takeaway.zh: Transformer 由熟悉操作按特定结构组合而成。逐分支追踪，并说明选择的变体。

meaning.en: The representation carried through repeated additive shortcut paths.
meaning.zh: 沿连续加法捷径传递的表征。

meaning.en: The same small network applied separately to each token’s feature vector.
meaning.zh: 同一个小网络分别作用于各词元特征向量。

meaning.en: Normalize the input to a sublayer before applying that sublayer.
meaning.zh: 在应用子层之前先归一化其输入。

question.en: Which part mixes information between tokens?
question.zh: 哪部分在词元之间混合信息？

answer.en: Attention does. Layer normalization and the feedforward network here operate within each token row. Residual addition combines matching positions.
answer.zh: 注意力负责混合。这里层归一化与前馈网络在每个词元行内部工作，残差相加组合对应位置。

question.en: Why are the second attention weights exactly 0.5 each?
question.zh: 第二行注意力权重为何各为 0.5？

answer.en: Its two allowed key vectors are identical. Their scores and exponentials match, so each gets half the total weight.
answer.zh: 允许读取的两个键向量相同，分数与指数相同，因此各分得一半权重。

question.en: Is this the exact block from the original paper?
question.zh: 这是原论文的完全相同模块吗？

answer.en: No. We explicitly use pre-normalization and one head with identity projections. The original paper uses a different normalization placement and richer parameterization.
answer.zh: 不是。这里明确使用前置归一化、单头与恒等投影。原论文的归一化位置不同，参数结构也更丰富。

body.en: Replace only the second input row. Under the causal mask, the first output row should not change. Test this to verify the block’s information boundary.
body.zh: 只替换第二个输入行。在因果掩码下，第一输出行不应改变。可用此测试模块信息边界。

body.en: Set W₂ to all zeros and keep b₂ zero. The block output equals the first residual result Y. This isolates what the second sublayer adds.
body.zh: 把 W₂ 设为全零，保持 b₂ 为零。模块输出等于第一次残差结果 Y，能够单独观察第二子层的贡献。

title.en: Run a complete toy pre-norm block
title.zh: 运行完整玩具前置归一化模块

intro.en: Identity attention projections and repeated rows keep the result inspectable.
intro.zh: 恒等注意力投影与重复行让结果容易检查。

code_examples.code:
import numpy as np
def layer_norm(values):
    centered = values-values.mean(axis=-1,keepdims=True)
    return centered/np.sqrt((centered**2).mean(axis=-1,keepdims=True)+1e-8)
x = np.array([[1.,-1.], [1.,-1.]])
u = layer_norm(x)
scores = u @ u.T / np.sqrt(u.shape[1])
allowed = np.tril(np.ones((len(x),len(x)),dtype=bool))
scores = np.where(allowed,scores,-np.inf)
weights = np.exp(scores-scores.max(axis=1,keepdims=True))
weights /= weights.sum(axis=1,keepdims=True)
y = x + weights @ u
w1 = np.eye(2); w2 = 0.5*np.eye(2)
z = y + np.maximum(0,layer_norm(y) @ w1) @ w2
print('attention:', np.round(weights,6).tolist())
print('first residual:', np.round(y,6).tolist())
print('block output:', np.round(z,6).tolist())

explanation.en: layer_norm centers each token’s feature row. tril builds a lower-triangular causal permission mask. where assigns forbidden scores negative infinity. Stable row softmax supplies mixing weights. y adds attention to the original residual stream. The final expression normalizes, applies a two-layer ReLU network with zero biases, and adds its correction. Every weight is fixed for teaching; no language training or pretrained weights are used. np.eye(2) creates that 2-by-2 identity matrix. Multiplying it by 0.5 puts 0.5 on the diagonal and keeps the other entries zero.
explanation.zh: layer_norm 中心化每个词元的特征行。tril 建立下三角因果许可掩码，where 把禁止分数设为负无穷。稳定逐行 softmax 给出混合权重。y 将注意力加回原残差流。最后表达式归一化后，应用零偏置的双层 ReLU 网络，再加回修正。所有权重固定用于教学，没有语言训练或预训练权重。 np.eye(2) 创建这个 2 × 2 单位矩阵。把它乘以 0.5 后，对角线元素变为 0.5，其余元素仍为零。

title.en: Transfer learning: adapt features without losing the evaluation boundary
title.zh: 迁移学习：适应特征，同时守住评估边界

story.en:
Lina has a small set of photographs of handmade ceramic tiles. Training a large image model from scratch soon memorizes them. She tries features from a pretrained encoder and learns only a new final classifier. The first validation score looks excellent. Then she finds nearly identical photos of one tile in both sets.

Lina splits whole tiles and photography sessions apart. She rebuilds the frozen-feature baseline and then tests limited fine tuning. A separate test set stays untouched. She now asks two questions: which weights need to change, and which evidence can fairly justify changing them? Reused features do not remove the need for a reliable experiment.
story.zh:
莉娜有一小批手工陶瓷砖照片。大型图像模型从头训练时，很快记住这些照片。她改用预训练编码器的特征，只学习新的最终分类器。初次验证分数很高，但她发现同一砖块的近似照片同时存在于两边。

莉娜按完整砖块与拍摄批次隔离数据，重新建立冻结特征基线，再测试有限微调。独立测试集始终保留。现在她问两个问题：哪些权重需要改变，什么证据能公平支持改变？复用特征不会消除可靠实验的必要性。

concept.en:
Transfer learning starts with parameters learned on an earlier task. An encoder turns an input into a feature vector. A prediction head maps that vector to the new answer. Freezing the encoder means not updating its parameters. Fine tuning updates some or all of them.

Useful transfer depends on the old features matching the new task. Preserve the expected preprocessing. Also decide what to do with mutable state, such as batch-normalization running statistics. Freezing gradients alone does not freeze that state. Choose changes with validation and keep the final test independent.
concept.zh:
迁移学习从先前任务学到的参数开始。编码器把输入变成特征向量，预测头把向量映射为新答案。冻结编码器指不更新其参数；微调则更新部分或全部参数。

迁移是否有用，取决于旧特征是否适合新任务。要保持预训练模型要求的预处理，并决定如何处理批归一化运行统计等可变状态。只冻结梯度不会冻结这些状态。通过验证选择改动，并保持最终测试独立。

application.en: Begin with a frozen feature baseline and preprocessing compatible with the selected pretrained weights. Define train, validation, and test groups before tuning. When unfreezing layers, explicitly include their parameters in the optimizer and decide how normalization statistics should behave. Compare changes on the same validation protocol, record the selected checkpoint, and evaluate the held out test set only after model selection is complete.
application.zh: 先建立冻结特征基线，并采用与选定预训练权重兼容的预处理。调参之前确定训练、验证和测试分组。解冻层时，显式将其参数纳入优化器，并决定归一化统计量如何运行。在相同验证流程下比较变化，记录选定检查点，并在模型选择完成后再评估保留测试集。

practice.en: PyTorch’s transfer tutorial adapts an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet to ants and bees. It demonstrates fine tuning and a fixed feature extractor with a new final layer. Its phases separate training from validation and retain a selected checkpoint. The tile-photo story and fixed-vector head calculation here are original.
practice.zh: PyTorch 迁移教程把 ImageNet 预训练 ResNet 用于蚂蚁与蜜蜂，演示微调及固定特征提取器配新最后一层。其流程分开训练与验证，并保留选定检查点。这里的砖块照片故事与固定向量预测头计算均为原创。

topics.formula:
z = fθ(x), s = wᵀz + b, p = 1/(1+exp(−s))
L = −y log(p) − (1−y) log(1−p)
w_new = w − η(p−y)z
b_new = b − η(p−y)
θ_new = θ

symbols.en: x is an input and fθ is the pretrained encoder with parameters θ. z is its fixed feature column vector. w is the classifier’s weight vector, wᵀ is its transpose, b is its scalar bias, and s is the raw score. p is the sigmoid probability of class one; y is a binary target, either zero or one. L is binary cross entropy, log is the natural logarithm, and exp is the exponential. η is the learning rate. The new subscripts denote simultaneous updates; unchanged θ specifies a frozen encoder for this calculation.
symbols.zh: x 是输入，fθ 是参数为 θ 的预训练编码器。z 是它输出的固定特征列向量。w 是分类器权重向量，wᵀ 是其转置，b 是标量偏置，s 是原始分数。p 是通过 sigmoid 得到的类别一概率；y 是取零或一的二元目标。L 是二元交叉熵，log 是自然对数，exp 是指数函数。η 是学习率。下标 new 表示同步更新后的数值；θ 保持不变，说明本次计算使用冻结编码器。

calculation.en: Suppose the frozen encoder returns z = [2, −1]. Start the head at w = [0.1, 0.2], b = 0, and use target y = 1. The raw score is 0.1×2 + 0.2×(−1) = 0, so p = 0.5 and L ≈ 0.693147. The weight gradient is (0.5−1)[2, −1] = [−1, 0.5], and the bias gradient is −0.5. With η = 0.1, the new weights are [0.2, 0.15] and the new bias is 0.05. The new score is 0.4 − 0.15 + 0.05 = 0.3. Thus p ≈ 0.574443 and L ≈ 0.554355. The encoder did not change. This lower loss on one training example says nothing by itself about whether fine tuning would improve independent validation data.
calculation.zh: 假设冻结编码器返回 z = [2, −1]。预测头初始值为 w = [0.1, 0.2]、b = 0，目标为 y = 1。原始分数为 0.1×2 + 0.2×(−1) = 0，因此 p = 0.5，L ≈ 0.693147。权重梯度为 (0.5−1)[2, −1] = [−1, 0.5]，偏置梯度为 −0.5。取 η = 0.1，新权重为 [0.2, 0.15]，新偏置为 0.05。新的分数为 0.4 − 0.15 + 0.05 = 0.3。因此 p ≈ 0.574443，L ≈ 0.554355。编码器没有改变。一个训练样本的损失下降，本身并不能说明微调是否会改善独立验证数据上的表现。

limits.en: Pretraining can transfer irrelevant features or biases, and aggressive fine tuning can erase useful ones. Repeated validation comparisons can overfit the validation set even without direct gradient updates. Small datasets leave substantial uncertainty. A frozen backbone also needs an explicit policy for running statistics and preprocessing; parameter freezing alone is not a complete reproducibility plan.
limits.zh: 预训练可能迁移无关特征或偏差，而过于激进的微调可能破坏有用特征。即使没有直接进行梯度更新，反复比较验证结果也可能过拟合验证集。小数据集仍带来较大不确定性。冻结主干还需要明确运行统计量与预处理策略；仅冻结参数并不是完整的可复现方案。

takeaway.en: Reuse useful representations, change only what evidence supports, and protect the validation and test boundaries that make adaptation claims credible.
takeaway.zh: 复用有用表征，只进行证据支持的调整，并保护验证与测试边界，让关于适应新任务的结论值得信任。

meaning.en: A model component that turns an input into numerical features.
meaning.zh: 将输入变成数值特征的模型组件。

meaning.en: The final component mapping features to the task’s answer.
meaning.zh: 把特征映射为任务答案的最终组件。

meaning.en: Updating previously learned parameters using a new task’s data.
meaning.zh: 用新任务数据更新先前学到的参数。

question.en: Which values change when only the head trains?
question.zh: 只训练预测头时哪些值改变？

answer.en: The head weights and bias change. Encoder parameters remain fixed. The example assumes a supplied fixed feature vector and has no mutable encoder state.
answer.zh: 预测头权重与偏置改变，编码器参数不变。本例假定固定特征向量已给定，没有可变编码器状态。

question.en: Why does the first score equal zero?
question.zh: 为什么初始分数为零？

answer.en: Multiply matching entries: 0.1×2+0.2×(−1)+0=0. Sigmoid of zero gives probability 0.5.
answer.zh: 对应项相乘后相加：0.1×2+0.2×(−1)+0=0。零的 sigmoid 为概率 0.5。

question.en: Does a lower loss after this step justify unfreezing the encoder?
question.zh: 这一步损失降低，是否足以支持解冻编码器？

answer.en: No. It shows only that one head update helped one training case. Compare freezing and fine tuning with a valid validation protocol.
answer.zh: 不够。它只说明一次预测头更新改善一个训练样本。冻结与微调需要按有效验证流程比较。

body.en: Assign all photos of one tile to one split. If sessions introduce shared lighting, account for those groups too. Near-duplicate views are not independent tests of new tiles.
body.zh: 将同一砖块的所有照片放在同一集合。若拍摄批次带来共同光照，也要考虑这些分组。近似视角不是对新砖块的独立测试。

title.zh: 固定特征的预测头更新

body.en: Run the code and verify that z never changes. The head’s score rises from 0 to 0.3. This isolates the update from any encoder adaptation.
body.zh: 运行代码并确认 z 从未改变。预测头分数由 0 升至 0.3。这样能把预测头更新与编码器适应分开。

title.en: Train a head on fixed features
title.zh: 在固定特征上训练预测头

intro.en: A supplied vector stands in for an encoder output; no pretrained model is loaded.
intro.zh: 用预设向量代替编码器输出，不加载预训练模型。

code_examples.code:
import numpy as np
z = np.array([2.,-1.]); w = np.array([0.1,0.2]); b = 0.; y = 1.
def probability(weights, bias):
    return 1/(1+np.exp(-(weights @ z+bias)))
p = probability(w,b)
gw = (p-y)*z; gb = p-y
w, b = w-0.1*gw, b-0.1*gb
new_p = probability(w,b)
print('new weights:', np.round(w,3).tolist())
print(f'new bias: {b:.3f}; new probability: {new_p:.6f}')
print(f'loss before: {-np.log(p):.6f}; after: {-np.log(new_p):.6f}')
print('fixed features:', z.tolist())
code_examples.output:
new weights: [0.2, 0.15]
new bias: 0.050; new probability: 0.574443
loss before: 0.693147; after: 0.554355
fixed features: [2.0, -1.0]

explanation.en: probability computes the head’s dot product and sigmoid. For binary cross-entropy, p−y is the derivative with respect to the raw score. Multiplying by z gives weight gradients. The update changes w and b only. Because y=1, the loss is −log(p). The example trains one small head step; it does not demonstrate that real pretrained features transfer well.
explanation.zh: probability 计算预测头点积与 sigmoid。二元交叉熵对原始分数的导数为 p−y，乘 z 得到权重梯度。更新只改变 w 与 b。由于 y=1，损失为 −log(p)。示例训练微型预测头一步，不能证明真实预训练特征迁移有效。

title.en: Low-rank adaptation and a checkable inference path
title.zh: 低秩适应与可检查的推理路径

story.en:
Ivo wants to adapt a large text model to short equipment notes. Updating every weight would require many trainable values and optimizer states. He studies a smaller change: keep a base matrix fixed and learn a product of two thin matrices.

Before using real model weights, Ivo tries the algebra on a tiny table. He counts the adjustable entries and compares two ways to compute an output. One keeps the correction as a separate branch. The other merges it into the base matrix. Their answers match within floating-point tolerance. He has verified an implementation idea, while task accuracy and real speed still need separate measurement.
story.zh:
伊沃想让大型文本模型适应短设备笔记。更新全部权重需要许多可训练数值与优化器状态。他研究较小改动：固定基础矩阵，只学习两个瘦矩阵的乘积。

使用真实模型前，伊沃先在微型表上检查代数。他统计可调整项，并比较两种输出计算：一种保留独立修正分支，另一种把修正并入基础矩阵。两种答案在浮点容差内一致。他验证了实现思路，但任务准确率与真实速度仍需另行测量。

concept.en:
Low-rank adaptation represents a weight change as BA. A compresses the input to r coordinates; B expands that correction to the output width. Rank is the number of independent directions a matrix can produce. Choosing a small r limits the update’s directions and trainable entries.

With fixed base W₀, the output is W₀x+sB(Ax). For a fixed adapter, the effective matrix W₀+sBA gives the same mathematical result. This merge can remove the extra adapter branch during inference. It does not remove the base model’s storage or guarantee a speedup in every system. Compare quality and resource use separately.
concept.zh:
低秩适应用 BA 表示权重变化。A 把输入压缩到 r 个坐标，B 将修正扩展到输出宽度。秩表示矩阵能产生多少独立方向。小 r 限制更新方向与可训练项数。

固定基础 W₀ 时，输出为 W₀x+sB(Ax)。适配器固定后，有效矩阵 W₀+sBA 在数学上给出相同结果。合并可在推理中移除额外适配器分支，但不会消除基础模型存储，也不保证每个系统都加速。质量与资源使用需分别比较。

application.en: For language adaptation, compare a frozen-feature or prompt baseline with any parameter update. Record which matrices are adapted, the rank, and the scaling. Before using a merged model, check numerical agreement on representative inputs and evaluate the intended task.
application.zh: 语言适应中，将任何参数更新与冻结特征或提示基线比较。记录适应了哪些矩阵、秩与缩放。使用合并模型前，在代表输入上检查数值一致性，并评估目标任务。

practice.en: The original LoRA paper proposes frozen base weights with trainable low-rank updates for language models and discusses merging. The tiny example demonstrates its matrix identity and parameter count. It makes no claim about the paper’s benchmark performance or a real adapted model.
practice.zh: LoRA 原论文为语言模型提出冻结基础权重、训练低秩更新，并讨论合并。微型示例演示矩阵恒等式与参数数量，不声称复现论文基准成绩或真实适应模型。

topics.formula:
W_eff = W₀+sBA
y = W₀x+sB(Ax) = W_eff x
P_adapter = r(d_in+d_out); P_full = d_in d_out

symbols.en: W₀ is a fixed d_out×d_in base matrix. x has d_in entries and y has d_out. A has shape r×d_in and B has shape d_out×r. r is the chosen rank bound and s a fixed scale. W_eff is the merged matrix. P_adapter counts trainable adapter entries; P_full counts entries in the full matrix. Biases are omitted here.
symbols.zh: W₀ 是固定的 d_out×d_in 基础矩阵，x 有 d_in 项，y 有 d_out 项。A 形状为 r×d_in，B 为 d_out×r。r 为选定秩上界，s 为固定尺度，W_eff 为合并矩阵。P_adapter 统计可训练适配器项，P_full 统计完整矩阵项。这里省略偏置。

calculation.en: Take input width 4, output width 3, and r=1. A has 4 entries and B has 3, giving 7 trainable entries instead of 12. Let x=[1,2,3,4], A=[1,0,−1,0], and B=[0.1,0.2,0.3]ᵀ. Then Ax=−2 and B(Ax)=[−0.2,−0.4,−0.6]. With s=1 and base output [1,2,3], the final output is [0.8,1.6,2.4].

limits.en: Low rank restricts possible updates and may miss changes the task needs. Fewer trainable entries do not imply a smaller base model or universally faster inference. Quantized weights and other representations can make merging more complicated. The example uses ordinary floating-point arrays and supplied adapter values.
limits.zh: 低秩限制可用更新，可能遗漏任务需要的变化。可训练项少，不代表基础模型更小或推理普遍更快。量化权重等表示可能让合并更复杂。本例使用普通浮点数组与预设适配器值。

takeaway.en: Separate trainable-parameter savings, numerical equivalence, task quality, and measured inference cost.
takeaway.zh: 区分可训练参数节省、数值等价、任务质量与实测推理成本。

meaning.en: A matrix can express only a small number of independent output directions.
meaning.zh: 矩阵只能表达少量独立输出方向。

meaning.en: A small trainable correction attached to a fixed base model.
meaning.zh: 附加在固定基础模型上的小型可训练修正。

meaning.en: Computing outputs with a selected model without fitting its weights on the query.
meaning.zh: 用选定模型计算输出，不在查询上拟合其权重。

question.en: Why are there seven adapter entries?
question.zh: 为什么适配器有七项？

answer.en: A is 1×4 and B is 3×1. Add their sizes: four plus three. The fixed twelve-entry base matrix still exists.
answer.zh: A 为 1×4，B 为 3×1，大小相加为四加三。固定的十二项基础矩阵仍然存在。

question.en: Why can the adapter be merged?
question.zh: 为什么可以合并适配器？

answer.en: Matrix multiplication distributes over addition: (W₀+sBA)x equals W₀x+sB(Ax). Floating-point ordering can cause tiny numeric differences.
answer.zh: 矩阵乘法对加法满足分配律：(W₀+sBA)x 等于 W₀x+sB(Ax)。浮点运算顺序可能引起微小数值差别。

question.en: Does seven trainable entries prove better quality than twelve?
question.zh: 七个可训练项是否证明质量优于十二项？

answer.en: No. It describes the optimization parameter count. Quality needs validation; speed and memory need measurement under the real execution setup.
answer.zh: 不能。这只描述优化参数数量。质量需要验证，速度和内存需要在真实执行配置下测量。

body.en: For a 100×100 weight matrix, compare rank 2 and rank 8. Adapter counts are 400 and 1600, versus 10000 full entries. More adapter capacity still needs validation.
body.zh: 对 100×100 权重矩阵比较秩二与秩八。适配器项数为 400 与 1600，完整矩阵为 10000。更大适配能力仍需验证。

body.en: Run both computation routes for several fixed input vectors. Compare with allclose rather than exact floating-point equality. Keep the original base and adapter available when checking the merged result.
body.zh: 对多个固定输入运行两条计算路径。用 allclose 而非浮点完全相等比较。检查合并结果时保留原基础矩阵与适配器。

title.en: Compare separate and merged adapter paths
title.zh: 比较独立与合并适配器路径

intro.en: All matrices are supplied for arithmetic; none are pretrained or fitted.
intro.zh: 所有矩阵都为算例预设，既未预训练，也未拟合。

code_examples.code:
import numpy as np
base = np.eye(3,4)
a = np.array([[1.,0.,-1.,0.]])
b = np.array([[0.1],[0.2],[0.3]])
x = np.array([1.,2.,3.,4.]); scale = 1.
separate = base @ x + scale*b @ (a @ x)
merged = (base+scale*b @ a) @ x
print('full entries:', base.size, 'adapter entries:', a.size+b.size)
print('output:', np.round(separate,6).tolist())
print('merged agrees:', bool(np.allclose(separate,merged)))
code_examples.output:
full entries: 12 adapter entries: 7
output: [0.8, 1.6, 2.4]
merged agrees: True

explanation.en: eye(3,4) creates a rectangular identity-like base map. a compresses four inputs to one correction coordinate; b expands it to three outputs. The separate expression retains two routes. The merged expression adds the matrix correction first. size counts entries and allclose checks numerical agreement. No speed claim follows from this tiny calculation, and no model adaptation is trained.
explanation.zh: eye(3,4) 创建矩形恒等式基础映射。a 把四个输入压成一个修正坐标，b 再扩为三个输出。独立表达式保留两条路径，合并表达式先加矩阵修正。size 统计项数，allclose 检查数值一致。这个微型计算不支持速度结论，也没有训练模型适应。

title.zh: LoRA：大型语言模型的低秩适应

title.en: Tensors: give every axis a meaning
title.zh: 张量：让每个维度都有含义

body.en: Treat every tensor axis as a named contract; matching dimensions is necessary, but preserving their meaning is what makes the computation correct.
body.zh: 把每个张量维度视为有名称的约定；维度匹配是必要条件，而保留其含义才能保证计算正确。

title.en: Activations: put a bend between weighted sums
title.zh: 激活函数：在加权和之间加入弯折

body.en: An activation changes both the features passed forward and the slopes passed backward.
body.zh: 激活既改变向前传递的特征，也改变向后传递的斜率。

title.zh: 多层感知机：学习有用的中间特征

body.en: Nonlinear hidden layers matter because they change the available representations; extra linear depth alone cannot create a nonlinear decision rule.
body.zh: 非线性隐藏层的重要性在于改变可用的表征；仅增加线性层的深度，无法构建非线性的决策规则。

title.en: Softmax and loss: turn scores into a learning signal
title.zh: Softmax 与损失：把分数变为学习信号

body.en: Keep raw scores, normalized probabilities, and the loss as three distinct quantities.
body.zh: 区分原始分数、归一化概率与损失这三个量。

body.en: Preserve the example axis, trace each transformation, and count parameters independently of batch size.
body.zh: 保留样本轴，追踪每步变换，并将参数数量与批大小区分开。

title.en: Backpropagation: follow the chain of dependence
title.zh: 反向传播：沿依赖链求导

body.en: A gradient is a trace of dependency through the actual computation; preserve that trace before expecting an optimizer to improve the model.
body.zh: 梯度是实际计算中依赖关系的轨迹；在期待优化器改善模型之前，先确保这条轨迹保持完整。

title.en: Minibatches and optimizers: turn gradients into steps
title.zh: 小批次与优化器：将梯度转化为更新

body.en: Separate the gradient estimate from the update rule, and compare learning dynamics with batch size, normalization, and optimizer state visible.
body.zh: 区分梯度估计与更新规则，并在明确批次大小、归一化方式和优化器状态的条件下比较学习过程。

title.en: A training loop: predict, measure, update, validate
title.zh: 训练循环：预测、衡量、更新、验证

body.en: Keep parameter updates and model evaluation separate, and save the state that validation actually selected.
body.zh: 分开参数更新与模型评估，保存验证实际选择的状态。

title.en: Regularization: train with noise, evaluate deliberately
title.zh: 正则化：训练时引入噪声，评估时明确模式

body.en: Regularization is a training choice; evaluation mode and gradient recording are separate execution choices that must match the purpose of each pass.
body.zh: 正则化是训练选择；评估模式与梯度记录是独立的执行选择，都必须符合每次前向传播的目的。

title.en: Normalization: state which values share statistics
title.zh: 归一化：说明哪些值共享统计量

body.en: A normalization formula is incomplete until you name its axes, variance convention, and behavior at evaluation.
body.zh: 只有说明轴、方差约定与评估行为，归一化公式才完整。

title.en: Convolutions and residual paths: local evidence, preserved routes
title.zh: 卷积与残差路径：局部证据与保留的通路

body.en: Convolution shares local evidence across positions; residual connections preserve a route around transformations. Their benefits come from different structural choices.
body.zh: 卷积在不同位置共享局部证据；残差连接保留绕过变换的通路。两者的作用来自不同的结构选择。

title.en: Token embeddings: turn IDs into trainable vectors
title.zh: 词元嵌入：把编号变为可训练向量

body.en: Treat token IDs as addresses, preserve masks, and distinguish a lookup vector from a context-aware representation.
body.zh: 把词元编号当作地址，保留掩码，并区分查表向量与有上下文的表征。

title.en: Attention: retrieve context with learned comparisons
title.zh: 注意力：通过学习到的比较提取上下文

body.en: Attention chooses how to mix available context; dimensions, positional information, and masks determine what that choice can actually mean.
body.zh: 注意力决定如何混合可用上下文；维度、位置信息与掩码，共同决定这种选择究竟具有怎样的含义。

title.en: A Transformer block: combine the pieces
title.zh: Transformer 模块：把组件接起来

body.en: A Transformer is a structured composition of familiar operations. Trace each branch and state the chosen variant.
body.zh: Transformer 由熟悉操作按特定结构组合而成。逐分支追踪，并说明选择的变体。

title.en: Transfer learning: adapt features without losing the evaluation boundary
title.zh: 迁移学习：适应特征，同时守住评估边界

body.en: Reuse useful representations, change only what evidence supports, and protect the validation and test boundaries that make adaptation claims credible.
body.zh: 复用有用表征，只进行证据支持的调整，并保护验证与测试边界，让关于适应新任务的结论值得信任。

title.en: Low-rank adaptation and a checkable inference path
title.zh: 低秩适应与可检查的推理路径

body.en: Separate trainable-parameter savings, numerical equivalence, task quality, and measured inference cost.
body.zh: 区分可训练参数节省、数值等价、任务质量与实测推理成本。
